details: For nonempty finite binary concept classes on finite domains; the maximum ranges over nonempty subclasses.
proof: This is the teaching-cost specialization of elimination with monotone local costs: deleting competing concepts cannot increase the minimum size of a teaching sample for a retained target. The survey gives the full proof and treats both sequential and simultaneous elimination.
name: Recursive Teaching Dimension / Monotonic Minimum Teaching Set Size
proof_source: Survey Lemma le:tpd (Teaching plans and recursive elimination), applying Theorem thm:monotone-elimination with local cost ts(h,G).
